_comment: S3 BUCKET policy (a resource policy, not a role) granting CloudFront read
access via Origin Access Control. Apply to both dreamforge-web-* and
dreamforge-artifacts-*, changing the bucket name each time.
This is what lets both buckets stay fully private with Block Public Access
on while still serving the public site. The AWS:SourceArn condition is the
load-bearing part: without it, any CloudFront distribution in any account
